rule: IMAGE_1 for a dirty opening must be an empty-of-people dirty plate. Restored flats are not dirty openings. Career tiles and HUD captures are never IMAGE_1.

LOC-SKY.name: Sky Lagoon landing
LOC-SKY.camera: Ground-level three-quarter on one landing patch, castle and lake legible. Do not squeeze the 3x1 panorama.

empty_plate.use: Crop a 16:9 landing-patch window at full height. Do not bind the full 6144x2048 squeeze.

LOC-SKY.missing: No dedicated landing-patch still is registered as IMAGE_1. Career tiles in assets/flats/sky_lagoon/main/ are comparison-only.

LOC-BATH.name: Bubble Bathroom
LOC-BATH.camera: Tub left, sink/mirror centre, pink toilet right. Inserts keep a neighbor fixture. No reverse wall.

empty_dirty_plate.note: Was in Revision 4 and unused by A001. This is IMAGE_1 for all dirty bath openings.

LOC-POOL.name: Mermaid Pool
LOC-POOL.camera: From approved coping toward left-centre waterfall and right seahorse. Closer along this view. No second basin.

LOC-ART.name: Craft Room
LOC-ART.camera: Front-facing known wall. Left-front / rear-table / right-front inserts vary depth only.

LOC-HALL.name: Main Hall
LOC-HALL.camera: Runner axis, gold column, correct small themed doorway. Oblique insert joins the same wall.

LOC-STUFFIE.name: Stuffie Room
LOC-STUFFIE.camera: Dressed playroom front. Rescue inserts keep one room anchor and both pin positions.
LOC-STUFFIE.empty_plate_status: Dressed plate exists; confirm people_in_plate before bind.

LOC-ATTIC.name: Stone Attic
LOC-ATTIC.camera: Two ocean windows, columns, banners, chests, low shell light. Height may vary; windows may not move. No wooden attic.

arena_still.note: Reads as exterior/arena more than the two-window interior.

LOC-LAWN.name: Chapter 2 lawn patch
LOC-LAWN.camera: One playable middle lawn patch of the Sky Lagoon panorama. Never the full 3x1.

empty_plate.use: 16:9 crop of the playable patch only
